brands.name: Algorithm Surfboards
brands.short_description: Oceanside custom boards programmed in Shape3D and hand-tuned by shaper Brian Brown.

models.name: 2-Factor
models.description:
The 2xFactor – When one setup isn’t enough and you need to break the code wide open.

This is a modern twin that doesn’t just stop at two. With the option to run it as a twin, quad, or even a 2+1, this board gives you the freedom to rewrite the rules on how you want to draw your lines.

Here’s the program: A modern take on the classic tri‑plane hull — fast, frictionless speed down the line with that buttery rail‑to‑rail transition hull-heads obsess over. Add in a swallow tail and a stinger that tightens up the tail, and you’ve got a board that pivots on command without losing that skatey twin-fin release.

The 2xFactor thrives in clean open faces but still holds composure when things get punchy. It’s the upgrade for surfers who want variety in their quiver — but in one single board.

Features: 

Tri-Plane Hull Bottom = Lift and effortless speed with smooth rail-to-rail flow

Swallow Tail + Stinger Combo = Loose and skatey up front, locked-in drive off the tail

Multi-Fin Compatibility (Twin / Quad / 2+1) = Maximum versatility for any wave or style

Modern Rocker Profile = Quick acceleration and control in steeper sections

Balanced Volume Distribution = Easy paddling without sacrificing performance

models.name: BackUp
models.description:
The Backup – The ultimate hack for when the waves are behaving like a glitchy system error.  Now, this ain’t your average ride. It’s designed for everyone, from the young rippers to the seasoned old heads who’ve been in the game for years.

Here’s the secret code: An overall wide outline, a nose and tail that mean business, and a rounded diamond tail that’s as sharp as a 4K screen.  But here’s where the real magic happens – a single to subtle double concave with vee off the tail. It’s the formula for success in the face of adversity, giving you the edge when the waves are playing hard to get. This board isn’t just a great groveler it’s a statement.

So, when the waves are trying to mess with your flow, grab this board. It’s not about the perfect conditions; it’s about the perfect board for the conditions.

Features: 

Full Deck + Full Round Rails = Extra volume for paddling and flotation

Lower Overall Rocker = Early entry and overall speed

Subtle Single to Double Concave Bottom = Increased speed and maneuverability

5-Fin Setup = Versatility for multiple fin configurations

models.name: Ben Gravy Barrel Cuda
models.description: This high speed fish features a subtle single to double concave with vee running off a slightly deep wide swallow tail. That means it planes across flat faced, mediocre surf with ease as well as holding in steep beach break barrels. The Quad fin cluster increases hold and responsiveness in rounder waves, but allows for steady drive while dropping in on a vertical face. Be ready to get where you want to go on the face of a wave with a relatively flat deck blending into a full round rail. The Barrel Cuda is customized for Ben’s style of surfing that allows him to seamlessly transfer from his go to softtop to his favorite hardboard.

models.name: Ben Gravy Semi Pro
models.description: This super fast, forgiving, user friendly Stubby Shortboard features an overall low rocker and medium single into a deep double concave with a slight vee in the last few inches of the tail for both speed and control. A board that works for the average Joe as well as it works for the best surfer in the lineup, this is the perfect East Coast shortboard for anything from 2ft to 10ft. The Tri/Quad fin option makes it more versatile for someone wanting a shortboard feel that dominates in all conditions.

models.name: Ben Gravy The Menace
models.description: The outline of this Mid Length has the wide point behind center for maneuverability, This focuses the curve between your feet and into the back third of the board where you turn from. The rounded squash tail creates a very smooth turning radius for a longer board.

models.name: HD
models.description:
The HD is a High-Performance masterpiece that caters to intermediate and advanced riders, each detail crafted to perfection.

The bottom is powered with a decent amount of single to subtle double concave that provides lift designed to elevate your ride.

It has a low to medium amount of tail rocker, this board isn’t just about speed; it’s about control, allowing you to accelerate with a calculated finesse that only the best in the game understand.

The added entry rocker is the secret code for transitioning in and out of turns like it’s a carefully scripted plan, leaving nothing to chance.  it’s also got round, semi-full forgiving rails – the stability in the equation. Because in the world of surfing, stability is key.

Features: 

Full Round Rails = Extra control

Medium Rocker + Increased entry + lower exit rocker = Increased speed through turns

Deep Single to Double Concave Bottom = Increased speed and maneuverability

3-Fin Setup = Drive, release and sensitivity

models.name: Midi
models.description:
The Midi – When your shortboard isn’t getting enough waves and you’re not ready to give up performance.

This is a modern mid-length designed to bridge the gap between effortless wave catching and high-performance surfing. More paddle power, more speed, and more glide — without sacrificing the ability to push turns and draw clean lines.

Here’s the program: Added rail line and balanced volume get you into waves earlier and keep you moving through flat sections with ease. A refined outline and performance rocker profile maintain responsiveness under your feet, allowing the Midi to carry speed where shorter boards stall while still feeling lively when it’s time to turn.

The Midi thrives in everyday conditions but has enough performance built in to handle quality surf when it shows up. It’s the upgrade for surfers who want more waves, more speed, and more opportunities to surf at their best.

 

Features: 

Extended Rail Line = Earlier entry and effortless speed generation

Performance Mid-Length Outline = Increased paddle power without sacrificing maneuverability

Refined Rocker Profile = Speed through weaker sections with control in steeper waves

Balanced Volume Distribution = Easy paddling with responsive performance

Versatile Wave Range = Designed for everything from average days to surprisingly good ones

models.name: Optimizer
models.description:
The true crossover board is High Performance with a little extra float and width and a full forgiving rail. This board is built to give you Speed even though some flatter sections and all the sensitivity of a High-Performance board.

A medium continuous rocker with an increased entry rocker and slightly lower tail rocker for increased speed through turns and glide over flat sections.

Contest or not this is your key to any condition Good in bad waves and Good on the good ones too!

Features: 

Domed Deck + Medium Round Rails = Extra thickness for paddling & still goes rail to rail

Medium Continuous Rocker & Slightly Lower Tail Rocker = Increased speed through turns

Single to Double Concave Bottom = Increased speed and maneuverability

3-Fin Setup = Drive, release and sensitivity

models.name: Pixel Pusher
models.description:
The Pixel Pusher is the ultimate High-Performance Groveler for small to medium waves.

The wide point strategically sits slightly behind center, creating an elliptical curve, no hip, just smooth transitions. This board’s got a continuous, low tip-to-tip rocker getting up to speed real quick, even in the most mediocre waves. While the round tail gives the hold you need in steeper sections.

The bottom has a single concave smoothly blending into a semi-deep double concave between the fins with a slight V running off the trail. It’s all about precision, control, and maximizing your session.

It’s loaded with 5-fin boxes because versatility is key.

This board isn’t just a tool; it’s a calculated move.

Features: 

Domed Deck + Medium Round Rails = Extra thickness for paddling & still goes rail to rail

Lower Overall Rocker = Early entry and overall speed

Subtle Single to Double Concave Bottom = Increased speed and maneuverability

5-Fin Setup = Versatility for multiple fin configurations

models.name: Upgrade
models.description:
The Upgrade is the ultimate hardware for when the waves go viral.

A full Flatish deck with down round rails, giving you that float to glide through those barrels like a boss. A subtle single to double concave, making sure you carve through the waves like a pro. The Medium rocker runs tip-to-tip ensuring a smooth ride through areas of consequence.

But that ain’t all. “The Upgrade” comes equipped with a semi-widish outline in the front 2/3 of the board, giving you stability and control. And we didn’t stop there – finished it off with a pulled-in round pin, ’cause precision is the name of the game.

Whether you’re hitting the local break or jetting off in search of slabs, “The Upgrade” will enhance your vision.

Features: 

Full Deck + Low Round Rails = Extra thickness for paddling

Medium Overall Rocker = Early entry and overall speed

Subtle Single to Double Concave Bottom = Increased speed and maneuverability

5-Fin Setup = Versatility to ride Tri or Quad fin configurations
